actions.createAndSendEnvelope.descriptio: Upload a document and send it to one or more people to sign via DocuSign.
actions.createAndSendEnvelope.props.carb: Recipients who receive a copy of the completed envelope but do not sign.
actions.createAndSendEnvelope.props.docu: Documents to include in the envelope.
actions.createAndSendEnvelope.props.emai: Optional message body included in the signing request email.
Subject line of the email sent to all recipients.
actions.createAndSendEnvelope.props.sign: Recipients who must sign the envelope.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.findEnvelopeRecipients.descripti: Get the full list of people on a signing request — signers, viewers, and anyone copied.
actions.findEnvelopeRecipients.displayNa: Get People on a Signing Request
actions.getDocument.description: Download a document (or all documents) from a signing request as a file.
actions.getDocument.props.documentId.des:
The ID of the document to retrieve. Alternatively, you can use one of the following special keywords:

combined: Retrieves all of the documents as a single PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is true, the certificate of completion is included in the PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is false, the certificate of completion is not included in the PDF file.
archive: Retrieves a ZIP archive that contains all of the PDF documents and the certificate of completion.
certificate: Retrieves only the certificate of completion as a PDF file.
portfolio: Retrieves the envelope documents as a PDF portfolio.
actions.getEnvelope.description: Look up the full details of a signing request — status, recipients, and dates — using its ID.
actions.listEnvelopes.description: Find and list signing requests with optional filters like status, date range, or keyword.
actions.listTemplates.description: Search for reusable signing templates by name.
actions.listTemplates.props.templateName: Full or partial name of the template to search for.
actions.updateEnvelope.description: Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders, or edit the subject line on a signing request.
Used when operation is "Update Email Subject / Message". New body text for the signing email.
actions.updateEnvelope.props.emailSubjec: Required when operation is "Update Email Subject / Message". New subject line for the signing email.
actions.updateEnvelope.props.voidedReaso: Required when operation is "Void Envelope". Explain why the envelope is being voided.
auth.props.clientId.description: This can be obtained in your developer account from the<https://admindemo.docusign.com/authenticate?goTo=appsAndKeys|Apps and Keys> page. See the https://support.docusign.com/guides/ndse-admin-guide-api-and-keys|Docusign eSignature Admin Guide> for more information.
auth.props.impersonatedUserId.descriptio: This is a GUID identifying the Docusign user that you will be impersonating with the access token. Your own User ID can be found at the top of the<https://admindemo.docusign.com/authenticate?goTo=appsAndKeys|Apps and Keys> page
auth.props.privateKey.description: This is for the integration key you obtained above and can also be created on the <https://admindemo.docusign.com/authenticate?goTo=appsAndKeys|Apps and Keys> page. You only need the private key, and it can only be copied once. Make sure to retain it for your records.
auth.props.scopes.description: Comma-separated list of scopes. These represent the OAuth scopes (permissions) that are being requested. For eSignature REST API methods, use the signature scope. The impersonation scope is implied by the JWT Grant operation and does not need to be included. If the access token will be used for other Docusign APIs, additional scopes may be required; see each API's <https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/esign101/auth/|authentication> requirements
triggers.envelopeCompleted.description: Triggers when everyone has completed their signature and the document is fully signed.
triggers.envelopeCreated.description: Triggers when a new signing request (envelope) is created in DocuSign — whether sent immediately or saved as a draft.
triggers.envelopeDeclined.description: Triggers when a recipient refuses to sign, stopping the signing process.
triggers.envelopeDelivered.description: Triggers when every recipient has opened and viewed the signing request at least once.
triggers.envelopeSent.description: Triggers when a signing request is emailed out to recipients for the first time.
triggers.envelopeVoided.description: Triggers when the sender cancels an in-progress signing request before everyone has signed.
triggers.recipientAuthenticationFailed.d: Triggers when a recipient fails the identity verification step before signing.
triggers.recipientCompleted.description: Triggers when a specific person completes their signature on the document.
triggers.recipientDeclined.description: Triggers when a specific person refuses to sign the document.
triggers.recipientDelivered.description: Triggers when a specific person opens and views the signing request.
triggers.recipientSent.description: Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing email to a specific person.
